title: Estimated odds of a first-ever negative leap second by 2035

source.name: Negative leap second forecasting, discussed via timeanddate.com

notes: Because Earth's rotation has been speeding up since 2020, timekeeping researchers estimate roughly a 40% probability that a negative leap second (subtracting a second from UTC -- something never done before) will be required by 2035, with some forecasts suggesting it could come as soon as 2029 if the rotation trend continues.

points.label: Chance of a negative leap second by 2035
